## Passages
RESULT [weeds]: The dataset paper describes 7,700 instances in the individual-weed set and 2,390 in the aerial set, with YOLO, VOC and JSON labels. It is a data descriptor with no detection benchmark.
US [weeds]: Explains why ImageWeeds is a poor same-species test for cwd12. Its ragweed and waterhemp come from greenhouse pots and drone views, not hand-held cotton-field photos, so large score changes on it reflect capture domain as much as model quality. This is consistent with the 0.9604 -> 0.0006 swing being an artifact, not biology.
CORRECTION [weeds]: Confirmed: Data in Brief 2023, NDSU; 3,975 images (3,424 individual greenhouse images with a Canon 90D; about 551 aerial images with a DJI Phantom 4 Pro V2.0 at 12 ft); 5 species; 7,700 + 2,390 = 10,090 instances; TXT, XML and JSON labels; no detection benchmark.
